test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A cuboid with dimensions 24 cm × 16 cm × 10 cm is melted to form smaller cubes with sides of 4 cm. Determine the number of cubes that can be formed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of cubes = (Volume of Cuboid) ÷ (Volume of one Cube)

⇒ (24 × 16 × 10) ÷ (4 × 4 × 4)

⇒ (24 ÷ 4) × (16 ÷ 4) × (10 ÷ 4)

⇒ 6 × 4 × 2.5 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Dimensions of cuboid: L = 24 cm, B = 16 cm, H = 10 cm

Side of small cube (a) = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

Volume of Cube = (Side)³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4325c8a365d693adf45d898ad9bc32f79028b1a96f4086e5a7f9971ee0426d5.png] 

⇒ Total volume of the cuboid = 24 × 16 × 10

⇒ Total volume = 3840 cm³

⇒ Volume of one small cube = 4 × 4 × 4

⇒ Volume of one small cube = 64 cm³

⇒ Number of cubes = Total volume of cuboid ÷ Volume of one cube

⇒ Number of cubes = 3840 ÷ 64

⇒ Number of cubes = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all six faces is given by TSA = 2 × (LB + BH + HL).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside is D = √(L² + B² + H²).

Surface Area of a Cube

The total surface area of a cube with side a is 6a².
